Now’s your chance to be a part of television’s longest-running game show, featuring host Drew Carey, where audience members try to win cash and prizes. Check this off your bucket list!

SPECIALS COMING SOON:

Thanksgiving Special! (July 24, 7:30 AM)
The Price is Right is serving up a special Thanksgiving taping and you’re invited! Come on down and join us as we celebrate the season with big laughs, big cash and prizes, and plenty to be thankful for. Adding a touch of Thanksgiving is encouraged.
– Must be 18+ to attend.
 
Star Trek 60th Anniversary Special! (August 6, 7:30 AM)
Calling all Trekkies! The Price Is Right is boldly going where no game show has gone before with a special taping celebrating 60 years of Star Trek! Come on down in your best sci-fi inspired shirts—Starfleet colors, space-themed shirts—and get ready for an out-of-this-world chance to win huge cash and prizes. This is one TPIR adventure you won’t want to miss.
– Must be 18+ to attend.
